title: Rumi (Encyclopaedia Britannica, 1911)
summary: Jalal al-Din Rumi (1207 to 1273), the Persian poet and mystic of Konya whose Mathnawi is sometimes called the Qur'an in Persian, and whose followers formed the Mevlevi order of whirling dervishes. The article summarises his life and the character of his verse.
